data.one_liner: Checks rooting, jailbreaking, physical device status and correct app installation on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides static getters to determine if the device is rooted or jailbroken, if it is a real device, and if the app was installed from a legitimate store. The checks run natively on each platform.
use_when: You need to enforce security policies before allowing sensitive operations
You want to detect emulators or debug builds during runtime
avoid_when: You need advanced threat detection beyond rooting/jailbreaking
You require continuous monitoring or background services beyond simple checks
strengths: Simple API, no code generation, works on both Android and iOS
Supports background execution and recent Android SDKs
weaknesses: May return false positives in development environments
Limited to rooting/jailbreaking detection, not full security analysis
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec and import package; no special permissions required.
